lines.1: Today, Nagomi cleans my ears while my head rests in her lap.
lines.2: 「Senpai, please stop moving. You're making this difficult.」
lines.3: 「Sorry. Your lap is so comfortable that I can't help it.」
lines.24: 「Will Leo be happy when he learns I returned from my family home a day early?」
lines.25: 「He may have missed me while I was gone.」
lines.26: 「If so, I will have to scold him for lacking spirit!」
lines.28: 「Hm? No one here? Hey, I'm home!」
lines.29: 「The light upstairs was on... Has he fallen asleep?」
lines.30: 「Good. I'll wake him suddenly and give him a fright.」
